translation: The bones of the five fingers are called the hammer bones (錘骨), which is the name for the proximal segment (本節) of each finger. If they are broken by a blow, it is the same for all five fingers, and the swelling and pain spread to the connected parts, because their sinews are all connected to one another. The palm and the back of the hand, although their outer bodies are mixed and not divided, their bones within are formed by the proximal segments of each finger connected together.
